subject: Airbnb
title: Airbnb Was Kept Alive by Election Cereal
description:
How did boxes of election cereal keep Airbnb alive?
Investors had said no, so its founders made their own cereal and sold it at {fact1} a box, told from the founder's own account.
Sources: CNBC (Apr 2023).
